eyebrow.zh: 流式状态 · 挂起与续接

headline.zh:
先让出话轮，
再取回中断状态。
headline.en:
Yield the turn.
Recover the interrupted state.

sub.zh: TurnLedger 保存一轮输出被打断时的 cursor 与 payload，支持内存或 SQLite 存储，再把挂起状态交还给 adapter 继续处理。
sub.en: TurnLedger stores a turn’s cursor and payload at interruption, using memory or SQLite, and returns the suspended state to an adapter for continuation.

caption.zh: 把中断位置留给下一次续接
caption.en: Keep the interruption state for continuation.

body.zh: 接入方定义 token、步骤和子步骤位置。
body.en: The integration defines token, step and substep positions.

body.zh: 挂起记录可以携带剩余文本或部分工具参数。
body.en: Suspended entries can carry remaining text or partial tool arguments.

body.zh: 内存和 SQLite 使用同一账本接口。
body.en: Memory and SQLite share the ledger interface.

title.zh: 把中断位置留给下一次续接
title.en: Keep the interruption state for continuation.

body.zh: 长输出被打断时，应用需要知道哪些内容已经发出、哪些中间参数还没处理完。把这个位置显式保存，可以让接入方选择从剩余内容继续，而不是丢失状态后重播。账本保存状态，不会替任意模型或音频后端恢复内部执行。
body.en: An interrupted long response needs an explicit record of what was emitted and which intermediate work remains. Saving that state lets an integration continue with remaining content rather than replaying after losing its place. The ledger stores state; it does not restore arbitrary model or audio-engine internals.

body.zh: 四个构造文本片段 A/B/C/D 在索引 2 处中断。真实文本 adapter 的续接输出为 ABCD，显式 restart 对照为 ABABCD。另一轮将 cursor=2 和 remaining=CD 保存到 SQLite，关闭后重开并恢复，历史含 yielding/resuming，随后不可再次恢复同一挂起项。
body.en: Four constructed text chunks A/B/C/D are interrupted at index two. The real text adapter emits ABCD in continuation mode and ABABCD in its explicit restart comparison. A separate turn saves cursor=2 and remaining=CD in SQLite, closes and reopens the store, then restores yielding/resuming history with no pending resume left.

body.zh: TurnCursor 表示 token/step/sub_step，Ledger 缓存 report 的当前位置，suspend 写 yielding 记录，resume 取最近未恢复记录并写 resuming。Store 有 InMemory 与 SQLite 实现。文本 adapter 使用返回索引继续已知 token 列表；可选 LiveKit adapter 将事件接到账本，进一步恢复生成/播放仍由应用负责。
body.en: TurnCursor describes token/step/sub_step. Ledger caches positions reported by the caller, suspend stores yielding, and resume retrieves a pending entry and records resuming. Store has memory and SQLite implementations. The text adapter continues a known token list from the returned index. Optional LiveKit hooks update ledger state; restoring generation/playout belongs to the application.

body.zh: TurnLedger 保存一轮输出被打断时的 cursor 与 payload，支持内存或 SQLite 存储，再把挂起状态交还给 adapter 继续处理。
body.en: TurnLedger stores a turn’s cursor and payload at interruption, using memory or SQLite, and returns the suspended state to an adapter for continuation.

body.zh: 保存 cursor 不等于任意模型/语音流可以精确恢复，adapter 必须实现实际续接。
body.en: Saving a cursor does not make arbitrary model/audio streams resumable; the adapter must implement continuation.

note.zh: v0.1.0 的文本模拟器与真实 SQLite 关闭/重开。restart 是同一示例自定义的对照模式，不代表其他语音产品的默认行为；没有实际音频或模型请求。
note.en: The v0.1.0 text simulator and a real SQLite close/reopen. Restart is the example’s explicit comparison mode, not a claim about other voice products’ defaults. No actual audio or model request is involved.

body.zh: 四个构造文本片段 A/B/C/D 在索引 2 处中断。真实文本 adapter 的续接输出为 ABCD，显式 restart 对照为 ABABCD。另一轮将 cursor=2 和 remaining=CD 保存到 SQLite，关闭后重开并恢复，历史含 yielding/resuming，随后不可再次恢复同一挂起项。
body.en: Four constructed text chunks A/B/C/D are interrupted at index two. The real text adapter emits ABCD in continuation mode and ABABCD in its explicit restart comparison. A separate turn saves cursor=2 and remaining=CD in SQLite, closes and reopens the store, then restores yielding/resuming history with no pending resume left.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.10+。安装可能联网；下面的文本与 SQLite 示例无需音频、LiveKit 或模型服务。
body.en: Requires Python 3.10+. Installation may need network access; the text/SQLite demo needs no audio, LiveKit or model service.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/turnledger.git
cd turnledger
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .

limitations.zh: 保存 cursor 不等于任意模型/语音流可以精确恢复，adapter 必须实现实际续接。
limitations.en: Saving a cursor does not make arbitrary model/audio streams resumable; the adapter must implement continuation.

limitations.zh: 本轮只验证文本模拟和本地存储，未验证 LiveKit 或真实语音链路。
limitations.en: This example validates text simulation and local storage, not LiveKit or a real voice pipeline.
